reuse.why: Hooks the new check into ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, the pre-existing pre-link gate every provider link function already calls before creating banks or syncing.

duplication.why: The closed check is written once and not repeated per provider.

placement.why: The gate is the right layer (before any bank creation or sync), but the check is folded into a function whose name and contract are about duplicate links, not account state.

scope.why: Only the check and two focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers all providers, though ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked now does more than its name says; a rename or a sibling ensure function would read better.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyAi, akahu, enableBanking, fintegra).
